verdict.rationale: Angular is a web framework, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only mentions generic 'AI-forward resources and integrations' and an AI section with prompts and best practices (angular-docs-4, angular-docs-30), plus an llms.txt file (angular-probe-1). None of these documents an official MCP server an agent could connect to, and such adjacent AI features earn no credit.
